blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
At the intermediate level, a finance team does not handle one tax at a time. Income tax, corporate tax, VAT and payroll taxes all run in parallel, each on its own rhythm, and each one touching the same set of numbers from a slightly different angle. A salary entry affects payroll tax today, income tax this month, and eventually feeds into corporate tax at year-end. A single sale triggers VAT now and shapes profit for corporate tax later.

Because each tax looks at the same business from a different window, errors in one quietly cause questions in another. A payroll miscalculation this quarter may show up as a mismatch in next year's corporate return — and the tax office notices.

Good intermediate tax work is about seeing how the four big taxes connect, so that one clean set of records supports all of them at the same time.

items.q: According to the text, how does a finance team handle taxes at the intermediate level?
options: Several taxes in parallel, each on its own rhythm
Only the corporate tax matters
One tax at a time, in sequence
Payroll first, everything else at year-end
items.why: "Income tax, corporate tax, VAT and payroll taxes all run in parallel, each on its own rhythm."

items.q: What happens after a single sale, according to the text?
options: It only affects payroll tax
It replaces the income tax entry
It has no tax effect until year-end
It triggers VAT now and shapes profit for corporate tax later
items.why: "A single sale triggers VAT now and shapes profit for corporate tax later."

items.q: Why can an error in one tax cause questions in another?
options: Because payroll is always calculated last
Because each tax looks at the same business from a different window
Because VAT rates change every quarter
Because the tax office audits every company yearly
items.why: "Because each tax looks at the same business from a different window, errors in one quietly cause questions in another."

items.q: The text suggests that the author would most likely DISAGREE with which statement?
options: The four big taxes are connected through the same numbers
You can safely fix each tax in isolation without checking the others
A payroll mistake today can surface in next year's corporate return
One clean set of records can support all the taxes
items.why: Inferência: todo o texto defende que as taxas estão conectadas — tratar cada uma isoladamente contradiz a tese.

items.q: What does "and the tax office notices" most strongly imply?
options: The tax office corrects the records for you
The tax office rarely reviews small businesses
Only VAT errors are ever detected
Internal mismatches become visible and carry real consequences
items.why: Inferência: a frase reforça que uma inconsistência interna não fica escondida — ela é percebida e cobrada por fora.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry orientando um analista júnior. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, come sit next to me. See this one line? It's just a salary entry — one number. But watch what it does over the next twelve months, because this is where people get lost.

Today, it feeds the payroll tax. That's the fast one — it moves this pay run. This month, the same figure shapes the income tax withheld from the employee. So already, one entry, two taxes, two different rhythms.

Now stay with me, because at year-end that same salary becomes a cost in the corporate accounts, so it lowers the taxable profit. And although it feels far away now, it's the same number you keyed in this morning.

Here's my point. If you mistype it today, the payroll run looks fine, but the mismatch shows up months later in the corporate return — and by then nobody remembers the original entry. So I don't want four separate spreadsheets. I want one clean record that all four taxes can read. Get the number right once, and it stays right everywhere. Does that make sense?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What single item is Harry using to teach the junior?
options: A corporate tax return
A VAT invoice
A salary entry — one number
A payroll spreadsheet with four columns
items.why: "It's just a salary entry — one number. But watch what it does over the next twelve months."

items.q: According to Harry, what does the salary entry do THIS MONTH?
options: It triggers VAT on a sale
It shapes the income tax withheld from the employee
It has no effect until year-end
It becomes a cost in the corporate accounts
items.why: "This month, the same figure shapes the income tax withheld from the employee."

items.q: What happens to the same salary figure at year-end?
options: It becomes a cost that lowers the taxable profit
It is refunded to the employee
It doubles the payroll tax
It is deleted from the records
items.why: "At year-end that same salary becomes a cost in the corporate accounts, so it lowers the taxable profit."

items.q: Why does Harry warn that a typo is dangerous?
options: Because the number cannot be edited afterwards
Because the mismatch surfaces months later, when no one remembers the original entry
Because the tax office fines the employee
Because the payroll run will fail immediately
items.why: Inferência: o perigo não é o erro visível hoje, mas a inconsistência que aparece tarde, sem rastro da origem.

items.q: What is Harry ultimately recommending?
options: Letting the corporate team re-enter the number
One clean record that all four taxes can read
Checking each tax only at year-end
Keeping four separate spreadsheets, one per tax
items.why: Inferência: "I don't want four separate spreadsheets. I want one clean record… Get the number right once, and it stays right everywhere."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The four taxes run in parallel, not one after the other." In parallel means…
options: at the same time, side by side
in strict order, one at a time
on the same document
only at year-end
items.why: In parallel = em paralelo: ao mesmo tempo, cada um seguindo seu curso.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "One salary ___ can affect three different taxes over the year."
options: audit
entry
window
refund
items.why: Salary entry = lançamento de salário: o registro que dispara os efeitos nas taxas.

items.q: "A payroll ___ this quarter appeared as a mismatch in the corporate return." Choose the correct word.
options: salary
rhythm
record
miscalculation
items.why: Miscalculation = erro de cálculo, que reaparece como inconsistência mais tarde.

items.q: "Each tax looks at the business from a different window." Here, window means…
options: a deadline for filing
a physical office
a software screen
a point of view or angle on the same numbers
items.why: Window = janela, no sentido de ângulo/perspectiva sobre os mesmos números.

items.q: "The two returns did not match; the auditor flagged the mismatch." A mismatch is…
options: an inconsistency between figures that should agree
a missing signature
a duplicated invoice
a late payment
items.why: Mismatch = inconsistência: números que deveriam bater e não batem.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem no trabalho com impostos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The finance director still has to sign off on the year-end return." To sign off on means to…
options: read informally
reject outright
postpone indefinitely
formally approve
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We need to reconcile the payroll figures with the corporate accounts." To reconcile means to…
options: round the numbers up
file them separately
make two sets of figures agree
delete the differences
items.why: Reconcile = reconciliar: comparar dois conjuntos de números até que batam.

items.q: "A single sale can feed into the corporate tax at year-end." To feed into means to…
options: contribute to or become part of
cancel out
delay
replace
items.why: Feed into = alimentar, entrar como parte de outro cálculo.

items.q: "Let's flag up the mismatch before the audit starts." To flag up means to…
options: approve it
measure it exactly
raise it for attention
hide it quietly
items.why: Flag up = sinalizar, trazer à atenção antes que vire problema.

items.q: "If we get the entry wrong, errors will carry over into next year's return." To carry over means to…
options: disappear at year-end
be corrected automatically
pass on into a later period
double in size
items.why: Carry over = transportar-se para um período seguinte, arrastando o efeito.
